appointment_access.table: Monthly appointment access per clinic by appointment type, visit mode, time of day and whether an SMS reminder was sent. Use for no-shows and wait times by segment.

columns.region: Clinic's sales region: West, Central or East
columns.appointment_type: Appointment type, e.g. Therapy session (45 min), Sick visit
columns.time_of_day: morning (before 12:00), afternoon (12:00-17:00) or evening (17:00 and later)
columns.reminder_sent: True if an SMS reminder was sent for these appointments
columns.no_show_rate: Row-level no-show rate; never average it. Use the no_show_rate measure
columns.avg_wait_minutes: Average minutes patients waited in this row; weight by appointments (avg_wait measure)

claims_monthly.table: Monthly insurance claims per clinic, payer, procedure (CPT) code and denial reason. One row per month x clinic x payer x CPT code x denial reason. Recent months still have pending claims.

columns.month: Service month (first day of the month)
columns.region: Clinic's sales region: West, Central or East
columns.payer_name: Payer name, e.g. Larkspan Health Plan
columns.cpt_code: CPT procedure code, e.g. 90834 (psychotherapy, 45 min), 99215 (established visit, high complexity)
columns.cpt_category: E/M established, E/M new, Preventive, Behavioral, Lab or Procedure
columns.denial_reason_code: CARC denial reason on denied claims, e.g. CO-197 (prior authorization absent), CO-16 (missing information), CO-50 (not medically necessary), CO-109 (wrong payer), CO-97 (bundled), CO-29 (timely filing); null for paid or pending claims
columns.decided_claims: Claims the payer has decided (paid, denied or under appeal); excludes pending
columns.denied_claims: Claims denied, including those under appeal
columns.denial_rate: Row-level denial rate; never average it. Use the denial_rate measure
columns.paid_usd: Amount paid by the payer, USD
columns.denied_billed_usd: Billed value of denied claims, USD: the revenue at risk from denials

clinic_daily_ops.table: Daily operations per clinic: bookings, completed visits, no-shows, cancellations, waits, video and AI Scribe visits, active clinicians.

columns.appointments_booked: All appointments booked for that day
columns.no_show_rate: Row-level no-show rate; never average it. Use no_shows / appointments_booked
columns.avg_wait_minutes: Average minutes patients waited that day; weight by visits_completed
columns.p90_wait_minutes: 90th-percentile wait that day, minutes; do not average across days for a network figure
columns.ai_scribe_visits: Completed visits documented with AI Scribe
columns.active_clinicians: Clinicians with at least one completed visit that day

clinician_productivity_monthly.table: Monthly throughput per clinician: visits, days worked, AI Scribe share and note-writing time. Rows with active_days = 0 are months the clinician did not work.

columns.active_days: Days the clinician completed at least one visit (0 = did not work that month)
columns.visits_per_active_day: Row-level ratio; use the visits_per_active_day measure
columns.ai_scribe_share: Share of the clinician's visits documented with AI Scribe (0-1)
columns.avg_note_minutes: Average minutes to finish a visit note; weight by visits (note_minutes measure)

dim_clinic.table: One row per clinic (Kasterwell's customer, also called tenant) with its current subscription. Join every other table to it on tenant_id.

columns.tenant_id: Clinic identifier; join key for every table
columns.specialty: Clinical specialty: primary_care, behavioral_health, urgent_care, pediatrics, womens_health, dermatology
columns.region: Sales region: West, Central or East
columns.go_live_date: Date the clinic started using the platform
columns.plan_tier: Current plan: Starter, Growth or Enterprise
columns.seats: Licensed clinician seats on the current contract
columns.addons: Comma-separated add-ons turned on: sms_reminders, ai_scribe (empty = none)
columns.arr_usd: Annual recurring revenue, USD (12 x MRR); the revenue at stake at renewal
columns.renewal_date: Next contract renewal date (all are after the data end, 2026-10-31)
columns.subscription_status: active or at_risk (flagged by customer success)
columns.sms_reminders_enabled_date: Date the clinic turned on SMS appointment reminders; null = not enabled
columns.ai_scribe_enabled_date: Date the clinic turned on AI Scribe; null = not enabled

dim_payer.table: Insurance payers billed by Kasterwell clinics (all fictional). Join to claims_monthly on payer_id.

columns.payer_name: Payer name, e.g. Larkspan Health Plan
columns.regions: Regions where the payer operates (ALL = nationwide)

revenue_monthly.table: Kasterwell's own monthly invoice to each clinic (its SaaS revenue), as of 2026-10-31.

columns.month: Invoice month (first day of the month)
columns.invoice_status: paid, open (not yet due) or overdue (past due, unpaid)
columns.paid_date: Date paid; null if unpaid as of 2026-10-31
columns.days_late: Days paid after the due date (negative = early); null if unpaid

tenant_health_weekly.table: Weekly customer health per clinic: active clinicians vs seats, logins, visits, support tickets and CSAT. Weeks start on Monday; the latest week is 2026-10-26. Use for churn and renewal risk (playbook CS-02).

columns.weekly_active_clinicians: Distinct clinicians active on the platform that week
columns.seat_utilization: weekly_active_clinicians / seats for one clinic-week; can exceed 1 when a clinic uses more clinicians than it licenses (an expansion signal)
columns.avg_csat: Average CSAT (1-5) of rated tickets that week; null when no ticket was rated

documents.table: Kasterwell document corpus chunked by section: protocols, payer bulletins, product KB, policies, release notes. Source for AI Search.
